headline: Easy run completed; no further training today
summary: The early-morning brief prescribed 7 km easy in about 45–50 minutes. Garmin later recorded 6.72 km in 39m 28s (5:52/km), with average HR 151, training load 115 and aerobic effect 3.5. This was close to the prescribed distance but shorter and faster; take no further training today.

recommendation.title: No further training today
details: The planned easy run is complete. Do no further running, cycling, strides, hills, tempo work, intervals, or make-up distance today.
Optional only: 10–20 minutes of gentle mobility or easy walking if it feels restorative.
recommendation.alternative: Complete rest is the safe lower-load alternative.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop optional activity for pain, illness, dizziness, altered gait, unusual fatigue, chest symptoms, or other concerning symptoms. Symptoms and medical advice override Garmin scores.

signals.interpretation: The run was 0.28 km short of the 7 km target and quicker than the 45–50 minute easy-session duration.

signals.label: Route and device context
signals.interpretation: Climbing and device temperature can affect pace and heart rate; they are context, not proof of effort or heat strain.

caveats: Garmin sleep, heart-rate, HRV, stress, Body Battery, readiness, and load measures are wearable-derived; use trends alongside how you feel.
Today's stress and Body Battery values are incomplete morning measures.
Sleeping-heart-rate baselines exclude the current night and use the prior seven and fourteen valid nights.
Today's temperature is a city-level forecast; no route-level humidity or dew-point estimate was available.
The morning 7 km easy recommendation is retained in this report as the comparison point for the completed run.

run_assessments.assessment: mostly_followed — Garmin recorded 6.72 km in 39m 28s (5:52/km), average HR 151, maximum HR 167, training load 115, aerobic effect 3.5 and anaerobic effect 0.2. This was close to the prescribed 7 km easy run but 0.28 km shorter and quicker than the 45–50 minute target. The route gained 94.6 m and Garmin recorded 16–26°C; those are device/route context only.
